verdict.rationale: USCIS's own homepage lists "Check processing times" among its online case-management tools, so the service does publish processing times itself. That is the only mention, with no detail on granularity or freshness. Missing for 10: evidence that times are broken down by transaction/form type and office, evidence of how current the data is or how often it updates, documentation of the processing-times tool itself, independent or hands-on corroboration.
